naslov: Gemini 4 Carbon: Google's strongest model tops the leaderboard, but almost nobody can use it
opis:
Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Carbon two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon. It is built for long agentic coding tasks and cyber defense: finding, verifying and patching vulnerabilities. On the new version of the Artificial Analysis index it scores 59 points, good for first place.

Why it matters: You can't call it through the API yet, so nothing changes in your day-to-day work.

naslov: Android Studio opens up to third-party agents, and Android gets APIs for in-app AI
opis:
Android Studio Rabbit 2 introduces a "Bring Your Own Agent" option. Through the open Agent Client Protocol it supports more than 40 coding agents, including Claude Agent and Codex, and agents can use the emulator and Logcat (Android's system log).

Why it matters: Google and Apple (which recently gave apps MCP) are heading the same way: apps should expose their functions to agents.
